name: sourcey-docs
description: Build, migrate and review documentation sites with Sourcey: Markdown guides, OpenAPI and MCP references, Doxygen, Go and Rust, from a project's own sources.

interface.longDescription: Build, migrate and review a project's documentation with Sourcey: guides in Markdown, API references from OpenAPI, MCP server references, and C++, Go and Rust references, as a static site the project owns. Sourcey's startup offers data is a separate product.
capabilities: Migrate from Docusaurus, MkDocs, Mintlify or Astro
Add an OpenAPI or MCP reference
Review a site before it ships
defaultPrompt: Set up Sourcey docs for this project from its README and OpenAPI spec.
Migrate this Docusaurus site to Sourcey and show me what the report says.
Review this Sourcey site as a reader would, before it ships.
